## Research Experience

::: {.cv-section}

::: {.cv-entry}
::: {.cv-entry-meta}
2020–present
:::
::: {.cv-entry-body}
**Graduate Researcher** — [Cognitive Dynamics Lab](https://blogs.uoregon.edu/cognitivedynamics/home/), University of Oregon

- Research on rational analyses of internal/external information consumption and the influence of respiration on cognition
- Eye-tracking and respiration experiments in MATLAB/Psychtoolbox with serial device integration; online experiments in Python and JavaScript
- Statistical modelling in R: (sinusoidal) GLMMs, ANOVAs, t-tests, non-parametric tests
- Mentored five undergraduate students in honors projects
:::
